♡Family Today♡

The loud one. Get the outside things done this morning — thunder is expected after two, and the wind comes with it. Then three good days in a row.
  • Sep 13Bills at Houston, Jets at Tennessee — both at 1:00
  • Sep 26Harvest Moon, full at 12:48 p.m.
  • Nov 3Election Day
Had a migraine? Say so in the group chat — the day and roughly when — and the paper will mark it on the Barograph. Enough entries and we will know what the glass does before one hits.

☾The Almanac Sky☾

Waning crescent, 3%, in Leo — the last sliver before tomorrow night's new moon. Rose 4:52 a.m., sets 6:54 p.m.
Sun 6:48a – 7:36p · 12h 48m · 2h 35m shorter than June 21
New moon Thursday night, 11:26 · Harvest Moon Sat, Sep 26
Tonight Venus low in the west after sunset, gone by 8:45. Saturn rises in the east at 8:38 and is up the rest of the night. Jupiter comes up at 4:02 a.m. With the moon gone dark tomorrow, the next few nights are the darkest of the month — if the sky clears Thursday, that is the night for stars.

☰The Barograph · 14120☰

High · 68/100
30.04″
↓ falling fast
A day to be careful The barometer dropped from 30.25 yesterday to 30.04 this morning — the fastest fall the log has recorded, and it is still going down as the storm comes in. Fast drops are the ones that bring headaches on, so today is a real risk day for you. Keep the Ubrelvy within reach, drink more water than you think you need, and do not push through the afternoon if it starts. It levels off tonight and Thursday is calm again.

✶The Ledger✶

Brent crude, a barrel
$99
Oil is back at the door of $100 after this week's tanker strikes in the Gulf. The pump follows the barrel by about two weeks, so the number to watch is the one on the sign at the corner, later this month.

✶The National Wire✶

1

New Hampshire Sets Up a Senate Race That Could Decide the Chamber

Chris Pappas and John E. Sununu won Tuesday's primaries for the seat Jeanne Shaheen is giving up. It is one of a handful in November that decides who controls the Senate.

2

U.S. Destroys Five More Iranian Tankers

Central Command says crews were told to abandon ship first. Ten Iranian tankers have been hit in a week; Iran answered with missiles at a base in Jordan.

3

Marshals Find 79 Missing Children in Ohio

A month-long operation, the largest of its kind in the state. The children were 6 to 17; one 13-year-old was found in a crawlspace under a bedroom closet.

4

Twenty-Five Years Since September 11

Friday is the anniversary. Trump awarded the Medal of Freedom on Tuesday to Welles Crowther, the young man in the red bandanna who led people down from the 78th floor and did not come back.

☑ The Ballot · 55 days to Election Day · early voting Oct 24–Nov 1 · register by Oct 24

🏈The Gridiron🏈

Four Days to Kickoff
Bills · at Houston, Sunday 1:00 on FOX. The first real injury report of the season comes out today, and three names are on it: Khalil Shakir, still not practicing with an undisclosed injury, Terrel Bernard, and Chauncey Gardner-Johnson. The Texans are worse off — receiver Jayden Higgins is gone for the year with a torn knee, and Tank Dell and right tackle Braden Smith are out at least four games.
Jets · at Tennessee, Sunday 1:00 on CBS. Breece Hall is back at practice and trending toward playing after a groin injury cost him all of camp. Pass rusher Joseph Ossai is still week-to-week. Tennessee will likely be without Cedric Gray, who led the team in tackles last year and has a concussion from a UTV accident over the weekend. And Garrett Wilson, somehow, was left off the captains list.

⚑The Chase⚑

Flat and Fast at Gateway
Sunday at 3 on USA, from the mile-and-a-quarter oval outside St. Louis. Gateway is flat and egg-shaped, which rewards patience and punishes anyone who cooks the right-front tire early. Twelve of the sixteen Chase drivers had trouble at Darlington, so most of the field arrives needing a clean day more than a fast one. Hamlin still leads Bell by twelve.

★The Marquee★

1

Beyoncé Reopens an Album She Made in Two Weeks

A 31-track B'Day at twenty, remastered, with a duet built around Selena's vocal and a first collaboration with Maluma. The videos were recolored in 4K.

2

Country Music Reads Its Nominations Tomorrow

The 60th CMA Awards list comes out Thursday morning, part of it on Good Morning America. The show itself is November 18 in Nashville.

3

The Emmys Move to Monday

The 78th Primetime Emmys air September 14 on NBC, shifted off Sunday for a football game. Mariska Hargitay hosts; The Pitt leads with 25 nominations.

☾On This Day☾

September 9, 1776 — 250 years ago today, the Continental Congress resolved that the words “United Colonies” be dropped and the country be called the United States of America. It was a housekeeping vote, recorded in a single line.

✶Question of the Day✶

I get louder the farther away I am from you, and quieter the closer I get. What am I? Answer below the fold.
Question of the Day: Thunder. The rumble rolls when the lightning is far off; a close strike is a single sharp crack.
